race.description: Lj Hooker Property Specialists/ Gawler & Barossa Hcp (C1)
race.comment: MAYSOONFLY (6) has all the form on the board, and she recovered well after settling too far back here last time out when finishing runner-up for the third time from as many starts this prep. She is set to go one better. TORRITA (9) has been freshened since finishing fifth as the favourite at Murray Bridge just over 7 weeks ago. Her best form has been on this track, and she has each-way claims. MYSTIC MIND (7) won her maiden by a nose, and then was a sound third here last time out. She has had a subtle gear change since then, and should be right in the finish again. STOCKMAN'S CHOICE (1) won his maiden fresh up here by a head, and from a good gate, he can measure up again.
